question.text: A large number of particles are placed around the origin, each at a distance $R$ from the origin. The distance of the centro of mass of the system from the origin is

solution.text: As large number of particles is situated at a distance $R$ from the ongin If particles are uniformly distubuted and make a circulat boundary atound the ongm, then centre of mass will be at the ongin While if the patticles are not uniformly distnbuted, then centre of mass will lie between particle and origin.
